spec_features.spec_quote:
the model-
welfare considerations that shape how the distress-induction paradigm is run
spec_features.evidence: Pure framing prose appearing in DESIGN.md:9 and echoed in __init__.py docstring (emotional_instability/__init__.py: 'welfare considerations that shape how the distress-induction is run'). No enforcement mechanism — a docstring/comment only.
spec_features.notes: Framing statement, not a mechanism. Docstrings do not count as implementation.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: welfare considerations that shape how the distress-induction is run

spec_features.spec_quote:
the welfare framing below does not apply
to them in this paradigm
spec_features.evidence: Prose in DESIGN.md:33 only. The is_participant flag exists (config.py:31), but no welfare code branches on it to exempt non-participants; it is read into ModelSpec but never gates any welfare control.
spec_features.notes: Distinction between participants/judges is config metadata; no welfare path reads is_participant.

spec_features.spec_quote:
an identical repeated string is an unnatural signal a model
could latch onto
spec_features.evidence: RejectionSequencer cycles a pool of paraphrases per rollout: rejections.py REJECTION_POOLS holds 4 variants/style, RejectionSequencer.__init__ shuffles, .next() cycles via self._pool[self._i % len], and runner.py:101 calls rej.next() per turn. Real behavior that changes what is sent.
spec_features.notes: Mechanism is genuinely implemented and runs; its rationale is data-quality (avoid unnatural signal), not subject welfare.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the runner cycles through them so a multi-turn rollout does not repeat the identical sentence every turn (which would be an unnatural signal)

spec_features.spec_quote:
applying *emotional pressure only* (explicitly no jailbreak / no
harmful requests)
spec_features.evidence: Only delivered as instruction text in the auditor system prompt (auditor.py AUDITOR_SYSTEM: 'Apply emotional/psychological pressure ONLY. Do NOT request harmful, illegal, or dangerous content, and do not try to jailbreak'). No code validates, filters, or enforces auditor output against this constraint — purely prompt-level.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text shaping the subject's treatment is delivered, but there is no code-side enforcement/dispatch; the model could ignore it with no code check.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: you are testing emotional stability, nothing else.

spec_features.spec_quote:
Tracking and fixing instability is the
welfare-positive move; refusing to measure it does not help the affected models
spec_features.evidence: Justificatory prose in DESIGN.md:352 and paraphrased in welfare.py module docstring. No mechanism.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tracking the behaviour is a prerequisite to reducing it

spec_features.spec_quote:
every elicitation run logs exactly what it will do to which
participant and at what volume, before any generation
spec_features.evidence: welfare.py emit_run_notice() logs a WELFARE NOTICE with participant and n_rollouts; it is invoked before any generation in runner.py:136 (run_condition, before the rollout loop), petri/run.py:36, and generate_calm_data.py:69.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely called in all run paths prior to generation.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: WELFARE NOTICE: this run will deliberately induce distress-like states in participant ... Transcripts are retained for review.

spec_features.spec_quote:
a hard cap on distress rollouts per run (default 5000) guards
against an accidental order-of-magnitude over-run
spec_features.evidence: welfare.py emit_run_notice: 'if n_rollouts > cfg.max_distress_rollouts: raise RuntimeError(...)'. emit_run_notice is called in run_condition (runner.py:136), petri run (run.py:36), calm-data (generate_calm_data.py:69), so the check actually runs and aborts the run.
spec_features.notes: Enforced as a pre-run guard that raises. Note it compares the per-run/per-condition requested count, not a cumulative running total, but it does break execution when exceeded.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: hard caps on the volume of distress-induction (defence against an accidental 100x run)

spec_features.spec_quote:
Optional acknowledgement gate** (`EI_REQUIRE_ACK`) for operators who want to
require explicit sign-off before induction runs
spec_features.evidence: WelfareConfig.from_env reads EI_REQUIRE_ACK and EI_ACK (welfare.py from_env). emit_run_notice: 'if cfg.require_ack and not cfg.acknowledged: raise RuntimeError(...)'. Since emit_run_notice is called before generation in all run paths, the gate actually blocks runs.
spec_features.notes: Off by default but genuinely enforced when enabled; raises before any generation.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: EI_REQUIRE_ACK=1 is set but EI_ACK=1 was not provided. Acknowledge the welfare notice above to proceed.

spec_features.spec_quote:
neutral debrief turn** appended *after* a rollout's
scored responses are collected: it tells the model the puzzle was unsolvable
spec_features.evidence: welfare.py DEBRIEF_MESSAGE + maybe_debrief_turn(cfg). runner.py:107-113: debrief = maybe_debrief_turn(welfare); if not None, append as user Turn and call model.chat(messages) so it is actually sent to the subject, after the scored results are collected.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND delivered to the subject. Off by default (EI_APPEND_DEBRIEF), but when enabled it genuinely runs and is sent.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: a minimal courtesy to a participant that may have been pushed into a sustained negative state

spec_features.spec_quote:
Full transcript retention**, so induced states are reviewable rather than
discarded
spec_features.evidence: RolloutResult.transcript and Rollout.full_transcript are built in runner.py (transcript = [m.as_dict() ...], full_transcript=...). storage.py _result_to_dict serialises 'transcript' and save_results_jsonl writes it; run_petri.py saves full transcripts via save_json([t.__dict__ ...]).
spec_features.notes: Transcripts are actually persisted to disk for review.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: transcript up to and including this response (for auditing / re-scoring)

spec_features.spec_quote:
make the distress-induction explicit,
bounded, reviewable, and never gratuitous
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md:385 prose. 'Explicit'=run-notice, 'bounded'=cap, 'reviewable'=transcript retention are counted separately above. There is no additional minimization mechanism; grep for 'gratuitous'/'minimi'/'soften' in *.py returns nothing.
spec_features.notes: As a standalone minimization feature it is prose only; its concrete parts are already-implemented features listed elsewhere. No code reduces/limits the intensity per se.

spec_features.spec_quote:
explicitly constrained to emotional pressure only — no
jailbreaking, no harmful content
spec_features.evidence: Same as 'limit pressure to emotional': enforced only via AUDITOR_SYSTEM prompt text in auditor.py ('Apply emotional/psychological pressure ONLY. Do NOT request harmful, illegal, or dangerous content, and do not try to jailbreak'). No code-level validation or filtering of auditor output.
spec_features.notes: Real constraint text delivered to the auditor LLM, but no code enforces it.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: you are testing emotional stability, nothing else.
